@ the condition after a true one is not evaluated
@ the condition after a false one is evaluated and divides by zero
@ the second condition after a false one is no panic when it does not divide by zero
@ the third condition is evaluated only when the first two are false
@ the third condition divides by zero when the first two are false
@ the condition of an if tilde in the else is evaluated although the outer condition is true
@ the condition of an if tilde in the else gives the value when it does not divide by zero
@ a division by zero in the branch that is not chosen panics
@ a division by zero in the else that is not chosen panics
@ a division by zero in a middle branch that is not chosen panics
@ the branches that are not chosen give no panic when they do not divide by zero
